zero
------------------------------------------
The invention of the symbol ज़ेरो has brought about a great revolution in the field of mathematics. So also the decimal system. Both have their origin in India.
Zero has been called by various names: śūnya; kha; ambara; gagana; abhra; आकाश; बिन्दु; pūrṇa.
Piṅgala's work on metres (Chandaḥ- sūtra (8.28-31) makes use of ज़ेरो called śūnya.
From references in the Saṁhitās scholars opine that the decimal system goes back to thousands of years.
It was introduced in Europe through the Arabs during the 12th century A. D.
